SELECT s.id, s.sku_id, ps.sku_code AS sku_code, ps.name AS sku_name, ps.product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, s.quantity, s.locked_qty, s.deleted, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM stock s LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON s.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ac_main.sku_id, ac_main.low_stock_threshold, ac_main.out_of_stock_threshold FROM stock_alert_config ac_main INNER JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, MIN(CASE WHEN warehouse_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS priority FROM stock_alert_config WHERE deleted = 0 AND enabled = 1 GROUP BY sku_id ) ac_priority ON ac_main.sku_id = ac_priority.sku_id AND ((ac_main.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND ac_priority.priority = 0) OR (ac_main.warehouse_id IS NULL AND ac_priority.priority = 1)) WHERE ac_main.deleted = 0 AND ac_main.enabled = 1 ) ac ON ac.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND s.sku_id = #{skuId}
AND ps.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuCode}, '%')
AND ps.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuName}, '%')
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND w.warehouse_type = #{warehouseType}
AND s.quantity > COALESCE(ac.out_of_stock_threshold, 0) AND s.quantity <= COALESCE(ac.low_stock_threshold, 10)
AND s.quantity <= COALESCE(ac.out_of_stock_threshold, 0)
AND s.quantity > COALESCE(ac.low_stock_threshold, 10)
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
